nocolor.description: If true, disables ANSI color codes in the output (--nocolor).

nobinary.description: If true, suppresses the verbose bitwise binary representation (--nobinary).

html_output.description: If true, renders the output as an HTML document (--html).

class_format.description: If true, prints only the bit-count-mask (e.g., /24) for the address (--class).

network_address.description: The IPv4 address and netmask to calculate, e.g., '192.168.0.1/24' or '192.168.0.1 255.255.255.0'.

subnet_splits.description: List of subnet sizes to split the network into. Corresponds to -s n1 n2 n3. Empty list means no splitting.

range_mode.description: If true, deaggregates an address range (--range).
